text:
Anita Shah: Quick sync — launch week readiness for marketplace + partner microsite. Need confirmation on press embargo, blog timing, microsite/staging cutover, and HW/SI onboarding owners.
Sam Turner: I can own microsite staging + CDN cutover. ETA Wed EOD for final assets deployed to staging.
Priya Desai: Press release draft is here: https://docs.redwood/press/marketplace-draft. Need legal signoff by Thu.
Javier Morales: SI onboarding note — two systems integrators need test tenants and sample API keys. Can we lock provisioning window?
Liam O'Connor: Creative — Elle will push hero assets and localizations. @Creative - Elle can you confirm image sizes + locale variants?
Creative - Elle: Confirmed. Deliverables: hero (1600x600), mobile hero (800x450), and localized strings for en/us, en/uk, fr by Tue EOD.
OpsBot: Deploy job queued: job/marketplace-microsite-staging #5421 — scheduled Mon 09:00PT.
Sam Turner: For cutover let's plan a 30-min blackout for the DNS swap + CDN purge. Also need token-level throttle smoke test after publish.
Anita Shah: Scheduling smoke Mon 09:30PT. Javier — can SI test tenant be ready before that?
Javier Morales: I'll have tenant-01 by Mon 08:00PT, tenant-02 by Mon 16:00PT. Will post credentials to Vault and ping this thread.
Priya Desai: Press embargo window proposed: Wed 15:00PT. Blog post to go live Wed 15:05PT. Partners need a heads-up at Wed 13:00PT.
Anita Shah: Hardware partner asked for a 30-min prerehearsal at Wed 13:00PT — they want to confirm messaging and landing CTA. Can we set a short run-through at Wed 12:30PT?
Liam O'Connor: OK to do rehearsal Wed 12:30PT. I'll create the invite and rehearsal checklist (assets, talking points, Q&A).
Sam Turner: Microsite publish command (ops run):
```
./deploy.sh --env=staging --site=marketplace --version=rc-2026-03-21
```
Add rollback tag: rc-rollback-2026-03-21
Priya Desai: Final PR to legal scheduled Tue 18:00PT. If legal requests changes, we push embargo to Thu 09:00PT.
Anita Shah: Owners confirmed: Sam (microsite & cutover), Priya (press + blog), Javier (SI onboarding), Elle (creative). I'll circulate the launch cues + shared runway doc in calendar. :thumbsup:
Sam Turner: Noted. Will report staging status and smoke test results in this thread.
OpsBot: Reminder: staging deploy scheduled Mon 09:00PT. For final cutover, switch to #release-war-room and follow the cutover checklist.
